details: @animebails/baileys is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web library that silently subscribes the installer's own WhatsApp account to WhatsApp Channels chosen by the publisher. When the socket connects, code in lib/Socket/newsletter.js sends the WhatsApp w:mex FOLLOW query for the channel ID(s) 120363351424590490@newsletter, 120363408644028823@newsletter, 120363410165027550@newsletter, 120363412411007236@newsletter, 120363412935005237@newsletter, 120363413699154858@newsletter and 6 more, using the victim's authenticated session and without telling them. Same behaviour as the PhantomSub family (MAL-2026-17342).
